name: Electricity; at grid
description: Estimate of inputs for electricity of the grid using US electricity generating sources and IEA 2022 data for national electricity generation by source as a proxy for the average grid mix in China by electrical generation energy types. Electric power transmission and losses as well as energy industry use (as % of output) estimated to be 3.422%. Per IEA, electric power transmission and distribution losses include losses in transmission between sources of supply and points of distribution and in the distribution to consumers, including pilferage.
category: 22: Utilities/2211: Electric Power Generation, Transmission and Distribution

processDocumentation.timeDescription: The annual production volumes of electricity production amounts by source are taken from IEA statistics for China and are valid for 2022.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: The annual production volumes of electricity production amounts by source are taken from IEA statistics for China and are valid for 2022.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Average generation by source of electricity in China. Net Electricity Production is equal to the gross electricity production less the electrical energy absorbed by the generating auxiliaries and the losses in the main generator transformers. Hydro includes generation from pumped-hydro power stations. Coal also includes peat and oil shale where relevant. Per IEA, electric power transmission and distribution losses include losses in transmission between sources of supply and points of distribution and in the distribution to consumers, including pilferage.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Electricity total generation by source was expressed in gigawatt hours. Percentage of total electricity generation in 2022 in China (per EIA 2024 national data) by source type was used as input amounts in MJ for each electricity input (US electricity modules as proxy for electricity generation by fuel in China and EIA data as representative of average national grid mix).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription:
TREATMENT OF MISSING ENVIRONMENTAL DATA
The dataset does not consider electromagnetic fields or SF6 emissions during production or deconstruction of switchgear or those during transmission. The dataset does not consider zinc emissions from zinc-coated steel transmission towers or PCP emissions from PCP-coated wooden distribution poles.

TREATMENT OF MISSING TECHNOSPHERE DATA
Installation, maintenance, and decommissioning activities are not include; transmission infrastructure and associated emissions as well as general capital equipment are excluded. Shares of electricity generation by geothermal, tidal, and solar thermal energy are not included as their cumulative contribution is < 0.01% for the 2022 data year.

MASS BALANCE
The energy imbalance for this unit process is ~3.42 MJ to account for electric line loss, which is extrapolated from IEA data trends and added as a % to input requirements per MJ output.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: IEA data for China electricity generation by source were applied to electricity generation datasets from US as equivalent LCI data are unavailable for the China geographic scope.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Statistical data on the 2022 China grid mix are from EIA and secondary data from USLCI are referenced in the unit process.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription:
BOUNDARY CONDITIONS
Activities include generation of electricity by fuel type scaled to account for average national line losses in China.                                                     

DATA COLLECTION
Data are from IEA national statistics at www.iea.org.

UNCERTAINTY ESTIMATION
Uncertainty was not estimated and not included.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Secondary data for the annual production volumes of electricity production amounts by source are taken from IEA statistics for China for 2022.

reviews.details: Data compiled from statistics were cross-checked with those reported by another database and previous LCI studies.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication:
Created to represent grid mix of electricity for manufacturing in China.

SITUATION C2 -- ACCOUNTING
The intended application for this process is for accounting purposes as described in Goal Situation C1 from the ILCD Handbook's Detailed Guidance. LCA studies with this intended application offer "purely descriptive documentation of the system under analysis (e.g., a product, sector or country), without being interested in any potential consequences on other parts of the economy.” The studies categorized under Goal Situation C2 do NOT consider existing benefits outside the analyzed system such as recycling.
